research: add candidates c367-c414 and o301-o306 with configs and reports

Packed agents, overlays and build scripts for the c367-c414 line (terminal
routing/delivery, forecast guards, public-shadow responses, execution
repairs, order-uncertainty guard) and the o301-o306 line (hire floor,
farmer feed top-up, wheat fertilizer tour, berry expansion, overflow
reclaim), plus their validation configs and Korean reports.

Note: c396 and later embed compressed public opponent sources, so those
agent files are 4-12 MB each.
